A daily English digest of German professional basketball (easyCredit BBL),
generated by a self-hosted pipeline: multiple German sources per story,
combined into short original summaries with links to every source. Summaries
are machine-generated and validated automatically; errors are possible, the
linked originals are authoritative. Follow me on X at [@aaronmartinphd](https://x.com/aaronmartinphd).

```{=html}
<section id="bbl-dashboard" class="bbl-dashboard" aria-label="BBL dashboard" hidden>
  <section aria-labelledby="bbl-trend-title">
    <h3 id="bbl-trend-title">Rank over time</h3>
    <p class="dashboard-caption">Click a team name to follow its line. Click it again to show every team.</p>
    <div id="bbl-standings-trend"></div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="bbl-stats-title">
    <h3 id="bbl-stats-title">Player leaders</h3>
    <p class="dashboard-caption" id="bbl-leaders-caption">Top ten by per-game average, season to date through the selected week.</p>
    <div class="dashboard-leader-controls">
      <div class="dashboard-toggle" role="group" aria-label="Leader period">
        <button type="button" data-scope="season" aria-pressed="true">Season</button>
        <button type="button" data-scope="week" aria-pressed="false">Week</button>
      </div>
      <label id="bbl-leaders-week-label" hidden>Week ending <select id="bbl-leaders-week"></select></label>
    </div>
    <div id="bbl-player-leaders" class="dashboard-leaders"></div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="bbl-ratings-title">
    <h3 id="bbl-ratings-title">Team ratings</h3>
    <p class="dashboard-caption">Points scored and allowed per 100 estimated possessions, season to date through the selected week. Up and to the right is better; the dashed lines mark the league averages.</p>
    <div id="bbl-ratings-map" class="dashboard-map"></div>
    <p class="dashboard-map-actions"><button type="button" id="bbl-ratings-toggle" class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="bbl-ratings">Show the full ratings table</button></p>
    <div id="bbl-ratings" hidden></div>
  </section>
  <section aria-labelledby="bbl-lineups-title">
    <h3 id="bbl-lineups-title">Five-man units</h3>
    <p class="dashboard-caption">Lineups reconstructed from the official play-by-play and checked against box score minutes, season to date through the selected week. Ratings are points per 100 estimated possessions while the five were on the floor together. <span id="bbl-lineups-note"></span></p>
    <div class="dashboard-lineup-controls">
      <label>Team <select id="bbl-lineups-team"><option value="">All teams</option></select></label>
      <label>Minimum minutes <select id="bbl-lineups-minutes">
        <option value="10">10</option><option value="20" selected>20</option><option value="40">40</option><option value="60">60</option>
      </select></label>
      <label>Sort by <select id="bbl-lineups-sort">
        <option value="net">Net rating</option><option value="minutes">Minutes</option><option value="plusminus">Plus/minus</option><option value="offense">Offence</option><option value="defense">Defence</option>
      </select></label>
    </div>
    <div id="bbl-lineups"></div>
  </section>
  <noscript><p>The dashboard requires JavaScript.</p></noscript>
</section>
<script type="module" src="./dashboard.js"></script>
```
